sources.observation: System-scope execution configures propagation and incoming paths and passes both to namespace setup.

Inaccessible parent paths remove nested mount entries. The propagation-enabled flag remains set and the final incoming-path remount is still attempted after switching root. This error branch does not populate the mount-entry error path.

An upstream report reproduces status 226 with InaccessiblePaths=/run and an incoming-path remount failure. A maintainer recommends TemporaryFileSystem=/run. Its reported EPERM is not this deployment's errno evidence.
The manual warns that /run must support namespace and propagation setup, documents private temporary filesystems, and distinguishes host-side bind sources from unit-side destinations.
